runs.content: Fresnillo (LSE, FTSE 100, 2,689.00p ≈ $35.58) was bought as the day's value pick. It is a silver/gold miner at ~11.7x earnings with ~66% ROIC, ~40% below its January peak despite H1 revenue +75%, and was chosen as a precious-metals hedge on a day when an Iran-driven oil spike hit tech. DE was exited as a capacity trim (−5.49%, −$55; weakest position, momentum premise failed). No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.61 from T1 and CVX is $5.96 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,583 (+2.11% on $75,000).

Mettler-Toledo (NYSE, $1,533.48) was bought as the day's momentum pick. It is up ~35% over 3 months and near its 52-week high after a Q2 beat and a raised FY26 EPS guide, and Barclays lifted its target to $1,700 on 10-07; it is healthcare / lab-instruments momentum outside the AI-capex names the B scan also surfaced. RTX was exited as a capacity trim (−7.50%, −$75; weakest position, no thesis break). No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $2.34 from T1 and HPQ is $5.28 from T2. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,298 (+1.75% on $74,000).
